hero_video._note: Self-hosted loop behind the homepage hero. NOTHING TO CONFIGURE: drop hero.mp4 into static/video/ and it appears; delete it and the plain navy hero comes back. A hero.webm and hero-poster.jpg next to it are picked up automatically (the poster shows while the video loads, and to visitors who prefer reduced motion or have Data Saver on - they get a play button instead of autoplay). Easiest way to make all of them from any clip: python tools/make_hero_video.py <your video file>. Keep hero.mp4 under ~8 MB: 10-20 seconds, no audio. 'enabled': false hides it without deleting the files. 'src', 'webm' and 'poster' are optional overrides - paths relative to static/ - for different filenames.

services.name: Monthly Maintenance Plan
services.summary: Scheduled preventive maintenance that catches wear before it becomes downtime.
services.body:
A wash that gets looked at on a schedule breaks down less often, and when it does break, it breaks smaller. Our Monthly Maintenance Plan puts your equipment on a regular service interval — brushes, bearings, belts, chemical systems and the wear points that quietly drift out of spec between problems.

Each visit we inspect, adjust and document what we find, so you get a clear picture of what is holding up, what is coming due, and what to budget for. The goal is simple: fewer surprise closures, longer equipment life, and a wash that stays consistent from the first car of the day to the last.

Plans are built around your site and your equipment. Call us and we will put together a schedule that fits your tunnel.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Honest and non-specific - safe to show the client. Refine once C-4 answers land.

services.name: Tunnel Adjustments
services.summary: Dial in brush pressure, timing and chemical application for a consistent wash.
services.body:
A tunnel that is even slightly out of adjustment shows up in the finish — missed spots, uneven coverage, and chemistry that costs more than it should. We dial in the parts of the wash that drift over time: brush pressure and timing, applicator arches, chemical dosing, and the sequence cars move through.

The result is a cleaner, more consistent wash on less chemical and less wear. Whether you have noticed a drop in quality, added a new wash package, or simply have not had the tunnel tuned in a while, we will get it running the way it should.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Refine once C-4 answers land.

services.name: Conveyor Installation & Repairs
services.summary: Chain, roller and correlator work, from single repairs to full conveyor replacement.
services.body:
The conveyor is the one part of the wash that simply has to work — when it stops, the whole tunnel stops and the cars stop with it. We install, repair and rebuild conveyor systems end to end: chain, rollers, correlators, the take-up and the drive.

Whether you need a worn section brought back into spec, a failing component replaced, or a complete conveyor installed in a new or rebuilt tunnel, we handle it. And we will tell you honestly whether a repair or a replacement is the better call for where your equipment is in its life — because the cheapest fix today is not always the cheapest fix this year.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Refine once C-4 answers land.

services.name: Electrical Installation & Repairs
services.summary: Power distribution, motor circuits and controls for tunnel and bay equipment.
services.body:
Everything in the wash runs on the electrical system, and it is the one area where cutting corners is dangerous as well as expensive. We handle power distribution, motor circuits, controls and troubleshooting for tunnel and bay equipment — new installations, upgrades and repairs.

When something is tripping, failing intermittently, or simply wired in a way nobody can make sense of anymore, we diagnose it and fix it properly. For control panels specifically, we build our own UL508A Listed Motor Control Centers designed for car wash equipment.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Refine once C-4 answers land. Internal link to MCC intentional.

services.name: Vacuum Installation & Repairs
services.summary: Central vacuum systems, producers and drops, installed and kept running.
services.body:
Vacuums are a profit center that customers notice the moment they stop pulling. We install and service central vacuum systems and self-serve vacuum equipment — producers, motors, drops, hoses and the plumbing that ties them together.

Whether you are adding stalls, replacing a tired system, or chasing down a loss of suction, we will get your vacuums back to full pull and keep them there.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Refine once C-4 answers land.

services.name: Equipment Sales
services.summary: New and replacement car wash equipment, quoted to your site and throughput.
services.body:
Buying car wash equipment is a big decision, and the right choice depends on your site, your volume and your budget — not on whatever a catalog is pushing this quarter. We help you spec and source equipment that fits, and we quote it to your actual application.

Because we also install and service what we sell, we have a stake in recommending equipment that holds up. Tell us what you are trying to do and we will put together a quote.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Quote-request only for v1 (C-3) - no catalogue, no checkout.
services._note: C-3: scoped as quote-request only for v1. No catalogue, no checkout.

services.name: Reclaim & RO Service
services.summary: Water reclaim systems and reverse osmosis units serviced, repaired and rebuilt.
services.body:
Water is one of the largest recurring costs in a wash, and reclaim and reverse-osmosis systems are how you control it — when they are working. We service, repair and rebuild both.

Reclaim systems recover and recycle wash water so you buy and heat less of it. RO units produce the spot-free water customers expect on the final rinse. When your water quality slips or your usage climbs, it usually traces back to one of these, and we will get it sorted.
services._body_note: INTERIM copy (Claude, 2026-08-26). Refine once C-4 answers land.

about.body:
Wash Works Inc. is a car wash service and equipment company based in Lodi, California. We keep car washes running — maintenance, installation and repair across the whole site, from the conveyor and tunnel equipment to the electrical, water systems and vacuums.

We build UL508A Listed motor control panels under our Motor Control Centers line, sell and source equipment, and advise operators on everything from equipment selection to site decisions. We are also a sister company to New Wave Innovations Inc., a car wash parts manufacturer at the same Lodi address.

Whether you run a single wash or several, we are a single point of contact for keeping them clean, running and profitable.
